summary: Youlife Group Inc., a Shanghai-based educational and HR services company, filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim financial statements for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains XBRL-tagged balance sheet, income statement, equity, and segment data, plus references to prior de-SPAC accounting involving Distoken Acquisition Corporation, PIPE investors, warrants, and Class A/B shares. No transaction, tender, activist, strategic-review, or management-change event is disclosed. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation appears; this is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer periodic report, so no risk-arb angle applies.
